notes.title: Roadmap until the Steam release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today I want to share with you the development roadmap for Shattered Dreams: Redemption over the next few months, all the way to its release on Steam.

I can officially announce that the early access release on Steam is scheduled for January 28, 2026.

(This date will not change unless a major issue arises, and if that happens, I will inform you in advance.)

Now, here is the roadmap, with each step listed in chronological order:

Release of a new trailer before the October Steam Neo Fest

This will be the official trailer for the early access release of Shattered Dreams: Redemption.

October Steam Neo Fest – From October 13 to October 20

Shattered Dreams: Redemption will participate in the October Neo Fest, where you’ll be able to try out the free SFW demo on Steam.

The demo will go live a few days before the Neo Fest begins and will remain available for one month.

Steam build preparation

Steam release (version 0.6) on January 28, 2026

Release of Version 0.7 after the Steam release

Ideally, it will come out in February.

That’s the plan for the next few months — there’s a lot to prepare for the Steam launch.

The Steam release is really important to me and to the game, and that’s why I keep repeating it: 

The best way to support the game is to wishlist it on Steam if you haven’t already, or to talk about it to your friends.

Whether it’s one or the other, don’t hesitate — those small actions help a lot!

That’s all for this post. Before I go, I want to thank you once again for all the support you give the game — you have no idea how much it means to me.

With that said, see you next time !
